pr_title: Adding support for data streams with a match-all template
pr_body:
Right now you cna create a match-all data stream template. But when you actually create a data stream that matches the template, it fails an assertion, crashing the node if assertions are enabled If assertions are not enabled, the request to create the data stream causes an IllegalStateException.
The problem is that we do not return matching templates for hidden indices. We find a template for the data stream. But then when creating the index we do not find a matching template since the backing indices for data streams are hidden. So the backing index does not have any mappings, which is what triggers the assertion failure.
Closes #111204

issue_context.title: AssertionError hit if data stream matches match-all index template
issue_context.body:
I'm allowed to create a match-all data stream index template:
```
$ curl -X PUT "localhost:9200/_index_template/my-index-template?pretty" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d'
{
  "index_patterns": ["*"],
  "data_stream": { },
  "priority": 100,
  "template": {
    "lifecycle": {
      "data_retention": "30d"
    }
  },
  "_meta": {
    "description": "Template with data stream lifecycle"
  }
}
'
{
  "acknowledged" : true
}
```
But if i try to create a data stream that matches that template, my server crashes with an assertion error (if assertions are enabled):
```
$ curl -X POST "localhost:9200/my-data-stream/_doc/?pretty" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d'
{
  "@timestamp": "2099-11-15T13:12:00",
  "message": "GET /search HTTP/1.1 200 1070000",
  "user": {
    "id": "asdf"
  }               
}                           
'
```
The reason is that we ignore the matching v2 template because it's match-all and we're a creating the data stream's write index as a hidden index https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/metadata/MetadataIndexTemplateService.java#L1319, and then crash because there's no `@timestamp` field in the mapping:
```
[2024-07-23T10:13:53,678][ERROR][o.e.b.ElasticsearchUncaughtExceptionHandler] [runTask-0] fatal error in thread [elasticsearch[runTask-0][masterService#updateTask][T#5]], exiting java.lang.AssertionError: _data_stream_timestamp meta field mapper must exist
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateDataStreamService.validateTimestampFieldMapping(MetadataCreateDataStreamService.java:485)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.index.IndexMode$1.validateTimestampFieldMapping(IndexMode.java:69)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateIndexService.updateIndexMappingsAndBuildSortOrder(MetadataCreateIndexService.java:1355)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateIndexService.lambda$applyCreateIndexWithTemporaryService$2(MetadataCreateIndexService.java:478)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.indices.IndicesService.withTempIndexService(IndicesService.java:715)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateIndexService.applyCreateIndexWithTemporaryService(MetadataCreateIndexService.java:476)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateIndexService.applyCreateIndexRequestWithV1Templates(MetadataCreateIndexService.java:600)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateIndexService.applyCreateIndexRequest(MetadataCreateIndexService.java:424)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateIndexService.applyCreateIndexRequest(MetadataCreateIndexService.java:442)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateDataStreamService.createBackingIndex(MetadataCreateDataStreamService.java:405)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateDataStreamService.createDataStream(MetadataCreateDataStreamService.java:306)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateDataStreamService.createDataStream(MetadataCreateDataStreamService.java:204)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.metadata.MetadataCreateDataStreamService.createDataStream(MetadataCreateDataStreamService.java:129)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.action.admin.indices.create.AutoCreateAction$TransportAction$CreateIndexTask.execute(AutoCreateAction.java:261)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.action.admin.indices.create.AutoCreateAction$TransportAction.lambda$new$0(AutoCreateAction.java:120)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.service.MasterService.innerExecuteTasks(MasterService.java:1070)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.service.MasterService.executeTasks(MasterService.java:1033)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.service.MasterService.executeAndPublishBatch(MasterService.java:233)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.service.MasterService$BatchingTaskQueue$Processor.lambda$run$2(MasterService.java:1686)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.action.ActionListener.run(ActionListener.java:444)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.service.MasterService$BatchingTaskQueue$Processor.run(MasterService.java:1683)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.service.MasterService$5.lambda$doRun$0(MasterService.java:1278)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.action.ActionListener.run(ActionListener.java:444)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.cluster.service.MasterService$5.doRun(MasterService.java:1257)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.common.util.concurrent.ThreadContext$ContextPreservingAbstractRunnable.doRun(ThreadContext.java:984)
        at org.elasticsearch.server@8.16.0-SNAPSHOT/org.elasticsearch.common.util.concurrent.AbstractRunnable.run(AbstractRunnable.java:26)
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:1144)
        at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:642)
        at java.base/java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:1570)
```
When we made the initial request it was as a non-hidden index-like thing, and when we look for the template we find the match-all one that is a data stream template. Then we make the request to make the backing index itself as a hidden index (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/metadata/MetadataCreateDataStreamService.java#L401), don't find any templates, and blow up.
So it's valid to have a match-all template for a data stream... you just can't create any indices in that data stream.
We need to change the code so that it is not possible to hit this assertion error -- we either need to prevent users from making match-all data stream index templates, or allow hidden indices to use match-all templates.
comments: We've discussed this, and plan to allow hidden indices to be created in this case (that is, we will allow users to create a data stream template that matches `*`).
